items.stem: Which service is designed to ingest high-volume streaming events for a pipeline?

options.rationale: Correct: Pub/Sub is a scalable messaging service for event ingestion.
Cloud SQL is a relational database, not an event ingestion bus.
Looker Studio is for dashboards, not ingestion.
Secret Manager stores secrets, not events.

items.stem: Which TWO techniques reduce BigQuery query cost on a large table? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Partition the table so queries prune by date
options.rationale: Correct: partition pruning scans fewer bytes.

options.text: Select only the columns you need instead of SELECT *
options.rationale: Correct: BigQuery bills by bytes scanned per column.

options.text: Always run queries on the largest slot reservation
options.rationale: That does not reduce bytes scanned/cost per query.

options.text: Store everything as a single CSV string column

items.explanation: Correct: partitioning and selecting needed columns cut scanned bytes.

items.stem: A report that only needs hourly-updated totals, not instant results, is best served by:

options.rationale: Correct: batch fits periodic, latency-tolerant needs at lower cost.

options.text: A low-latency streaming pipeline for every event
options.rationale: Streaming adds cost/complexity not needed here.
Manual exports are not a reliable pipeline.

items.explanation: Correct: batch suits hourly, latency-tolerant reporting.
